Business Development Officer Job at Odixcity Consulting




        
    

        
        Odixcity Consulting is an International Hr consulting and procurement firm. With expertise in Recruitment & Selection, Performance management, Training & Development, Compensation and benefits as well as Outsourcing of goods and services for organizations.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Business Development Officer

Job Location: Trans-Amadi, Port Harcourt -  Rivers
Employment Type: Full- Time (ON-SITE)

Job Summary
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	You must have prior experience working in a recruitment firm, because you already understand the sales cycle, the pricing models, and the language of hiring managers and HR leaders.


Responsibilities


	Identify and research target companies that align with our recruitment niche and service offerings (e.g., tech startups, enterprise firms, healthcare providers etc).
	Conduct outbound prospecting via cold email, LinkedIn InMail, and strategic phone calls.
	Represent the company at networking events, industry conferences, and virtual meetups (as applicable).
	Design, deploy, and optimize email outreach campaigns using Instantly.io, Hubspot, Mailchimp, or equivalent platforms.
	Monitor delieverability, spam scores, and inbox placement rates.
	Use data to identify bottlenecks in the sales process and implement improvements.
	Update deal stages, next steps, and follow-up tasks daily.
	Stay current on recruitment industry trends, salary benchmarks, and competitor offerings.
	Gather client feedback and market insights to help refine our service offerings and marketing messages.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
	2-3 Years of proven experience in a business development, sales, or client acquisition role within a Recruitment Firm.
	Demonstrable track record of bringing in new client accounts. You must be able to provide specific examples of clients you have won and how you won them.
	Hands-on experience with Email Marketing tools- You must have built and deployed campaigns using at least one of the following; Instantly.io, HubSpot, Mailchimp, or Saleshandy.
	You must be Tech Savvy, and quickly learn new software, troubleshoot basic issues, and leverage automation to scale your outreach
	Experience recruiting for technology/engineering/ software development roles etc.
	Experience with Cold Calling alongside Email Marketing.


Renumeration


	Salary: N120,000 monthly
	Transport: N20,000
	Airtime Allowance: N10,000
	Total Salary: N150,000 monthly.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and cover letter to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

They are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Technical Operations Supervisor

Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time

Role Summary


	We are seeking a dependable Technical Operations Supervisor to plan, coordinate and supervise inspection and testing jobs in the field and workshop — ensuring work is delivered safely, on time, and to client and code requirements.


Responsibilities

	Ensure equipment is calibrated, serviceable and ready before every mobilisation
	Serve as the technical point of contact for client representatives on site
	Track job progress, productivity and non-productive time; report weekly to management
	Identify additional client needs on site and flag opportunities to the Business Development team
	Mentor and develop technicians and technical assistants.

	B.Eng / B.Sc / HND in Mechanical, Metallurgical, Materials, Production or a related engineering discipline
	Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in inspection services, including at least 2 years in a supervisory role
	Valid NDT certification (Level II or higher, ASNT SNT-TC-1A / PCN / equivalent) in at least two methods (UT, MT, PT, RT, VT)
